options.content:
Check collection, delivery and the central Loki backend. Agent panels follow the cluster filter. Central backend and storage panels show the shared backend across all clusters. N/A is missing telemetry. Host-local tail positions survive replacement, but the bounded 512 MiB WAL does not.

Green, amber and red indicate explicit status. Blue is quantitative emphasis. N/A means missing or unsupported data, never healthy zero.
